subject: Bluecastle renewal — health notes, billing questions, and forecast guidance
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluecastle.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, May 10 2028 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming renewal + worksheet attached

Hi Vivek —

Renewal for Bluecastle is up in mid-June and procurement asked me to get a firm sense of pricing and billing timing so we can align internal approvals. I've attached a simple worksheet with the current contract line items and the tentative expansion (we're looking at adding 2 additional seats and a small embedding volume increase). Current ARR is approximately $320,000.

We are tracking a couple of items that could cause slippage: (1) exec sponsor bandwidth — they have a leadership reshuffle, and (2) a short-term drop in query volume while they rework an internal pipeline. Procurement would like to know if we can commit to the quoted price and whether we can meet a June 20 invoice/PO timeline.

Can you confirm who from finance and CS should be on this thread for forecast and billing guidance? Also — do you need any further paperwork from our side?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Product
Bluecastle Inc.

Attachment: Bluecastle_Renewal_Worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluecastle.com>
Date: Fri, May 11 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + worksheet attached

Thanks Elena — looping in finance (Naomi), CS (Marissa) and AE (Ben) to assess stage and how this should sit in the May forecast. Quick asks: please confirm whether Bluecastle has raised a formal PO yet and whether legal needs any contract redlines (procurement cc'd).

Naomi / Marissa / Ben — can you do two things this week:
- Re-qualify the deal stage in HubSpot (use the "Renewal — at risk" vs "Renewal — commit" taxonomy) and leave a 1–2 line reason in the Deal notes. HubSpot link below.
- Recommend a forecast treatment for ARR this quarter (Include in committed ARR / At-risk / Exclude). If you recommend At-risk, please provide a probability % so I can roll into the forecast model.

Elena — we have the worksheet attachment; thanks for that. Naomi and I will coordinate billing timing. I expect Naomi to confirm whether we can support a June 20 invoice date given payment terms.

- Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluecastle.com
Date: Sat, May 12 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + worksheet attached — billing guidance

Quick finance read:
- We don't have a PO yet, so at this point I would treat $320K as At-risk for the May close. Recommend probability = 60%.
- If procurement returns a signed PO by June 4 and the contract terms match current SOW (no net-new SKUs), we can move to Commit and invoice the renewal with a June 20 target.
- Payment terms: standard 30 days. If Bluecastle needs Net45 we can accommodate but will need to know before issuing invoice.

One-time offer (if it helps with internal approvals): we can provide a 10% one-time credit on the incremental seats if the renewal is signed and invoiced by June 20. That would reduce the first-year ARR impact for the incremental lines only.

Attachment: billing_notes.pdf

Action items for you, Vivek / Ben / Marissa: please update HubSpot with the probability and the expected invoice date (if you plan to push for June 20). I'll mark a provisional forecast entry at 60% until we get a signed PO.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluecastle.com>
Date: Mon, May 14 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + worksheet attached — CS health update and next steps

Adding customer health context from our side:
- Usage: query volume down ~18% month-over-month after they switched a batch job to internal caching. Active monthly seats are stable but feature adoption for streaming endpoints has dipped.
- Support: no open Sev1s; two low-priority tickets around rate-limits that engineering has scheduled for next sprint.
- Exec sponsor: Elena's note about a leadership reshuffle is accurate — we've lost visibility to the original sponsor and are scheduling an intro to a new director.

Recommended actions (for the renewal call):
1) Set a renewal call for Tuesday, May 16 — propose: Elena, procurement, our AE (Ben), Naomi if procurement questions billing, and myself to cover adoption plan.
2) Prepare a short adoption plan (3 bullets) to show how a $0–$5k uplift in implementation support can restore streaming volume in 6–8 weeks.
3) Update HubSpot deal stage to "Renewal — at risk" and add the CS health note outlined above.

Given the adoption dip and sponsor change, I'm inclined to keep probability at 50–60% until the May 16 call. Please update the deal and I'll join the renewal call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
